results.question: Which branches had more closures than openings in Q2?

plan.reason: No metric can compare closures and openings directly per branch.
plan.sql: SELECT branch_code, SUM(CASE WHEN record_stat = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closures, SUM(CASE WHEN record_stat = 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS openings FROM core.cust_account WHERE closed_date IS NOT NULL OR account_open_date IS NOT NULL AND closed_date >= '2026-04-01' AND closed_date <= '2026-06-30' OR account_open_date >= '2026-04-01' AND account_open_date <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY branch_code HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN record_stat = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN record_stat = 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);
